hooks.name: Session Conventions Reminder
hooks.description: At the start of every session, reminds the agent of the key project conventions so they are applied consistently from the first message.

action.prompt:
A new session has started on the Task Manager App. Apply these conventions from the very first task:

STRUCTURE
- Backend files must follow the canonical layout in .kiro/steering/backend-structure.md
- Frontend files must follow the canonical layout in .kiro/steering/frontend-structure.md
- Never create files outside the defined folder structure without flagging it first

STYLE & PATTERNS
- Python: snake_case files/functions, PascalCase classes/schemas, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants
- JS/JSX: PascalCase components, camelCase hooks/utils, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE exported constants
- CSS: CSS Modules only (ComponentName.module.css), design tokens via --tm-* custom properties in index.css
- No inline style={{}} except truly dynamic values
- No Tailwind, no styled-components

BACKEND HARD RULES
- Never call Base.metadata.create_all() — all schema via Flyway migrations in app/db/migrations/
- Always use Mapped/mapped_column (SQLAlchemy 2.x declarative style)
- Ownership check (403) before existence check (404)
- All env vars through app/config.py Settings class — never os.environ.get() inline
- bcrypt cost factor ≤ 12

FRONTEND HARD RULES
- JWT token in React state only — never localStorage
- All API calls through src/api/client.js Axios instance — components never import client.js directly
- useTasks hook owns all task state — components read from it, never call API themselves
- Status values always from STATUS_VALUES constant in src/constants/taskStatus.js
- Tests: vitest --run (never watch mode)

GIT
- Always branch as feature/task-<n>-<slug> — never commit to main
- Commit message: feat(task-<n>): <description> / Closes #<issue>

If a developer mentions a task number, read .kiro/specs/task-manager-app/tasks.md first before writing any code.
